shadows.name: ambient
shadows.purpose: Resting cards on the screen surface. Barely perceptible; confirms elevation.

shadows.name: lifted
shadows.purpose: Main content scroll cards. Softer opacity; blur carries the depth.

shadows.name: fab
shadows.purpose: Floating action button only. The one intentionally visible shadow.

shadows.name: overlay-scrim
shadows.purpose: Modal backdrop. No blur; opacity only.

motion.name: press-state
motion.purpose: The only transition in the system. Opacity 1 to 0.88 on press.

narrative.overview:
Noru is peer infrastructure, not a dispatch platform. The design system reflects a familiar path worn smooth by daily use: confident without ceremony, readable at a glance, dark because students check this before dawn and between lectures, not under office fluorescents. Every surface exists to get a verified student into a ride faster than any other option.

The system rejects the commercial register entirely. No map-hero layouts. No gig-economy dispatch copy. No SaaS-cream dashboards. Trust is expressed through institutional signals: the university account badge, the face-verified avatar ring, the registration number in the profile overlay. These are facts, not features.

Design serves speed. A student standing at a stop at 7:45 AM does not browse. The primary action is always one tap from the home screen. Information density is earned.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first: deep charcoal surfaces with a single cobalt blue carrying all action meaning
Tonal depth: lighter = closer; darker = deeper; no decorative shadow stacks
Inter Bold / Inter Medium at high weight contrast; size contrast is secondary
Tactile press states: opacity 0.88, no bounce, no scale, no color shift
Verified face as UI element: the cobalt avatar ring appears at every scale where trust matters

rules.name: The Single Voice Rule
rules.body: Cobalt blue is the only action color. If something is pressable and consequential, it is cobalt. If it is cobalt, it is pressable and consequential. No secondary accent, no notification color, no section theming.

rules.name: The Status-Only Rule
rules.body: Grove (green) exists for open status and fare. Ember (red) exists for full status and danger. Both are forbidden in any other context.

rules.name: The Two-Weight Rule
rules.body: InterMedium (500) and InterBold (700) are the only weights in use. SemiBold is loaded but inactive. New work must not introduce it without deliberate justification.

rules.name: The No-Italic Rule
rules.body: Italic is used only in the moderation screen to distinguish user-reported quoted text from system copy. Forbidden everywhere else.

rules.name: The Tonal-First Rule
rules.body: If tonal contrast already expresses the depth relationship between two surfaces, do not add a shadow. Shadows confirm elevation; they do not create it.

rules.name: The FAB Exception
rules.body: The FAB is the only component with an intentionally heavy shadow. It must separate from scroll content. All other surfaces use ambient or none.

dos: Do use Cobalt Action (#1E6CCC) for every tap target that advances the student: join, host, submit, confirm.
Do use the tonal depth stack for elevation. Lighter = closer; never reverse this.
Do render the avatar ring (#60A5FA) at every size where a verified face appears.
Do use pill chips (999px radius) for filter and toggle controls.
Do express pressed state as opacity 0.88 only. No scale, no glow, no color shift.
Do uppercase section markers at 14px / 0.6 tracking for filter zone headers only.
Do restrict green to open status and fare, red to full status and danger actions.
donts: Don't style Noru like Uber or Lyft. No map-hero layouts, dispatch copy, or gig-economy commercial register.
Don't use SaaS-cream whites, teal accents, or hollow grid dashboards.
Don't introduce a second action color. Cobalt or nothing, in both dark and light themes.
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text with a gradient).
Don't use glassmorphism. No backdrop-filter: blur() on decorative card surfaces.
Don't default to a modal. Justify each modal independently.
Don't use the hero-metric template (large number, small label, gradient accent).
Don't add shadows to ride cards or standard cards beyond ambient.
